sections.name: Intro — ridge wind
sections.description: Wind and a two-note sword-memory cell; no voice yet.

sections.name: Verse I — the long ascent
sections.description: One traveler climbs; elapsed decades are counted through landscape rather than exposition.

sections.name: Pre I — second footfall
sections.description: Another footfall enters the wind; recognition remains withheld.

sections.name: Chorus I — names withheld
sections.description: The hook establishes mutual refusal to call a name or turn.

sections.name: Interlude — scabbard resonance
sections.description: Instrumental fracture of the hook; decades remain between two timbral planes.

sections.name: Verse II — changed rivers
sections.description: Both histories are implied through changed roads, towns, and scars on the scabbards.

sections.name: Pre II — recognition
sections.description: The old gait and gaze identify the other before either speaks.

sections.name: Anchor — passing on the cliff
sections.description: The full encounter: no greeting, no stop, hands tighten on hilts, shoulders narrowly pass.

sections.name: Afterimage — missing half bar
sections.description: A 2/4 bar removes expected time at the instant of passing; memory loosens without reconciliation.

sections.name: Final chorus — returned to rivers and lakes
sections.description: The hook returns transformed from refusal into mutual release.

sections.name: Outro — wind keeps neither name
sections.description: Two directions recede; the wind and water retain no name.

song.premise: The cliff wind witnesses two swordsmen, separated for decades, recognize one another on a path too narrow for ceremony. They do not greet, stop, draw, or reconcile; each tightens a hand on the hilt, passes, and releases the other back into rivers and lakes.
song.narrator_stance: IA is the impersonal ridge wind: close enough to register breath, gait, cloth, and scabbard resonance, but unwilling to explain either life or choose a victor.
song.addressee: Both travelers at once, with neither granted a private confession or reply.
song.central_tension: Recognition creates the possibility of speech or violence, while mutual restraint requires the encounter to remain in motion and incomplete.
song.state_at_start: One solitary ascent is framed as ordinary weather and accumulated time.
song.intended_destination: Two receding directions and a mutual forgetting that feels chosen, not erased or resolved.
song.listener_after: The listener should be able to recount the encounter while still feeling the unsaid decades as negative space.
creative_invariants: No lyric or arrangement event turns the crossing into a duel, victory, reunion, apology, or romantic reconciliation.
The largest lead-melody departure belongs to the tightened hilt, not to a greeting or heroic pose.
Audible silence and the single 2/4 measure carry narrative information before reverb or mastering is considered.
The title hook changes from refusal in Chorus I to mutual release in the final chorus.
Every vocal track uses original IA component BLRGDDR4M3WM2LC6; no IA_ROCKS or trial singer is present.

sections.dramatic_function: Establish wind, cliff scale, and a two-note object-memory without identifying a person.
sections.intended_transition: Let empty register and separated attacks make the landscape precede the travelers.

sections.dramatic_function: Count decades through moon, rain, clothing, and ascent rather than a biography.
sections.intended_transition: Keep the vocal line speech-shaped and mostly narrow while landscapes change underneath it.
sections.state_after: Time has accumulated without an explicit grievance.
sections.inherited_delivery: Close plain tone with syntax-sized breaths.

sections.dramatic_function: Introduce a second footfall before identity is known.
sections.intended_transition: Move from recitative repetition to two registral terraces; end on dominant tension without naming the arrival.
sections.state_after: Another presence is certain but unnamed.
sections.inherited_delivery: Tighten pulse while preserving air before the chorus.

sections.dramatic_function: State the refusal hook: neither names nor pursuit will bridge the distance.
sections.intended_transition: Use repeated anchor tones and contrasting phrase destinations so refusal is active rather than numb.
sections.state_after: The rule of non-pursuit is established.
sections.inherited_delivery: Connected accents only on semantic anchors; no global belt.

sections.dramatic_function: Break the hook into scabbard-like resonance and footsteps.
sections.intended_transition: Remove the voice and split the motif across distant registers.
sections.state_after: The next memory arrives through objects rather than explanation.
sections.inherited_delivery: Keep the arrangement dry enough that attacks remain separate.

sections.dramatic_function: Show changed rivers, rebuilt towns, and accumulating scabbard damage shared by both lives.
sections.state_before: The listener knows distance but not its cause.
sections.intended_transition: Transform the verse rhythm and peak order; do not repeat Verse I's normalized contour.
sections.state_after: Both histories feel long and parallel without being narrated symmetrically.
sections.inherited_delivery: More forward consonants, still below the anchor climax.

sections.dramatic_function: Make recognition happen through gait and gaze.
sections.intended_transition: Delay entry, compress around a pitch pedal, then leave a sokuon-sized silence before the final recognition syllable.
sections.state_after: The other is identified as 君 without speech.
sections.inherited_delivery: Plain opening, then one restrained increase in DYN.

sections.dramatic_function: Make the complete physical encounter legible in eight bars.
sections.state_before: Recognition has occurred at a distance.
sections.intended_transition: Move from an early high memory terrace to low cliff-space, accelerate through unbroken walking, then spend the only F5 on 柄を握り before descending into an A7 suspension.
sections.state_after: They have passed without greeting, stopping, or drawing.
sections.inherited_delivery: Lead first; harmony enters only after the midpoint and never takes the lead's peak.

sections.dramatic_function: Let the expected bar and expected reply both go missing.
sections.intended_transition: Use the 2/4 bar as a literal subtraction, then let descending fragments land on different banks.
sections.state_after: Silence becomes the only shared answer.
sections.inherited_delivery: Thin dynamics; leave the transient of the short bar exposed.

sections.dramatic_function: Transform refusal into mutual release toward rivers and lakes.
sections.intended_transition: Preserve the title cell but lower its last destination and simplify the final allocation.
sections.state_after: Forgetting is accepted as an action rather than an absence of memory.
sections.inherited_delivery: Broader support underneath, vocal still restrained.

sections.dramatic_function: Remove both names from the landscape.
sections.intended_transition: Contract the range, slow the pulse, and leave one tonic tone after the final word.
sections.state_after: Wind and water keep neither identity.
sections.inherited_delivery: Nearly plain tone, with no triumphant cadence.

lyric_anchor.text: 幾十年の向こうから／断崖の細い道／足も止めず　言葉も抜かず／剣も抜かず　柄を握り　すれ違う

phrase_directions.purpose: Compress the entire reunion into motion: recognize, approach, refuse speech and steel, tighten the hilt, and pass.
phrase_directions.addressed_to: Both travelers and the listening witness.
phrase_directions.subtext: The grip admits that violence and memory are present; continuing to walk is the chosen answer.
phrase_directions.state_before: They know who is approaching but still have distance in which to act.
phrase_directions.intended_transition: The melody must make the tightened hand the largest event, then remove heroic closure by descending into a suspended final D over A7.
phrase_directions.state_after: The other is physically behind them and no decision can become a conversation.
phrase_directions.delivery_arc: Begin as distant recognition, narrow at the cliff description, intensify through continuous walking, open once on the hilt, then cool immediately while forward motion continues.

realization_hypothesis.summary: Four non-isomorphic two-bar phrases—early peak, low repeated cliff band, accelerating pendulum, and leap-hold-release—make the narrative audible without prose narration between lines.
realization_hypothesis.melody: The only F5 is assigned to the grip; the last note is D4 over A7, not a tonic victory.
realization_hypothesis.rhythm: Entry positions move from downbeat to delayed and offbeat; the final line compresses seventeen morae around one long focus note.
realization_hypothesis.harmony: Dm–Bb–F–C opens perspective; Gm–Dm–Bb–A7 turns restraint into unresolved dominant space.
realization_hypothesis.register: The second phrase contracts to the cliff floor before the last phrase expands to a single earned peak.
realization_hypothesis.dynamics: DYN rises only into 柄を握り and falls before すれ違う.
realization_hypothesis.tuning: Plain early sustains, a small scoop into the grip peak, delayed vibrato only where a long vowel can carry it.
realization_hypothesis.arrangement_space: Harmony is absent for the first four bars; minimal band leaves the lead center unobstructed.
expected_evidence: Four phrase blueprints differ in entry, contour, rhythm, and cadence.
The semantic-focus lyric unit and its cell receive the local maximum pitch and longer-than-neighbor duration.
The final melodic event remains a non-chord suspension over A7 until the short afterimage bar.

listening_question.question: Across the fixed 40–48 passage, does the single high/long focus on 柄を握り followed by immediate descent and suspension make recognition, restraint, and passing legible without suggesting a duel or reconciliation?

lyric_anchor.text: 名を呼ばない　もう呼ばない／互いを忘れて　川と湖へ

phrase_directions.purpose: Return the title cell with the same refusal but a different destination: mutual release into the wider world.
phrase_directions.state_before: The encounter is already behind both travelers.
phrase_directions.intended_transition: Preserve the repeated-name rhythm while lowering its final contour and lengthening the last tonic so the hook stops asking for pursuit.
phrase_directions.state_after: Memory remains, but neither claims the other as unfinished business.
phrase_directions.delivery_arc: Firm but no louder than the anchor; broaden vowels, then strip the final word of flourish.

listening_question.question: Does the transformed hook sound like chosen mutual release rather than amnesia, defeat, or a happy reunion?
